info.name: EN - Big City Greens (2018) (US)
info.director: Shane Houghton, Chris Houghton, Monica Ray

info.plot: The offbeat adventures of 10-year-old Cricket Green, a mischievous and optimistic country boy who moves to the big city with his wildly out of place family – older sister Tilly, father Bill and Gramma Alice.
